purpose: Synthetic input values for player names, chat, search, and profile fields.

cases.expected: Reject or apply the documented default; never crash.
Accept only if the documented minimum length permits one character.
Apply the documented maximum length consistently.
Reject or truncate according to product rules without UI overflow.
Render, persist, and compare supported Unicode consistently.
Text remains readable and input direction is handled safely.
Trim or preserve whitespace according to documented rules.
Display as safe text; do not interpret user text as markup.
Reject or normalize unsupported control characters without breaking layout.
